what: Live TP-hit rate vs Stage-0 harness TP-hit rate, pooled across legs. xrp_pullback_2h is one instance: 1 TP in 14 paired live packages (bybit_1/bybit_2) and 4 of 52 pooled live closes vs 16 of 53 in its Stage-0 record (P of <=4 at 0.30 is 1e-4); entry, SL and TP placement match across books, so it is not an execution-price defect there. Question for every rostered leg: does the live book hit take-profit at the harness rate, on the same price-return basis (not R on a journaled stop, which live review tightens)? Output: a per-leg table of live TP share vs Stage-0 TP share with n on both sides, and the legs where live is below the harness beyond chance. A gap across legs means the harness TP model is not trusted for promotion evidence; a gap on one leg is that leg's problem.
